value.rationale: The valence-five Clebsch graph is a natural unique strongly regular (16,5,0,2) folded-cube benchmark with full affine symmetry. A complete integral homotopy type and nontrivial 4+5 decomposition of top homology for all 1920 symmetries supply structural information beyond the adjacency spectrum, simple Betti rank, and previously computed neighborhood/matching complexes. The exact rational representation is reusable for natural comparison and equivariant questions; the result is finite but motivated.
